description: nf-core/detaxizer samplesheet context, aligned to the pinned 1.3.0 schemas. Identifies and optionally removes contaminating sequences from raw data.

tax2filter.help: The taxon to identify (and optionally remove). Defaults to human, i.e. host removal.

enable_filter.help: FALSE by curated default: identify first and let a human look before anything is deleted from the reads.

classification_kraken2.help: Needs a Kraken2 database, which Luria does not host.

validation_blastn.help: Second-pass confirmation with BLAST; needs a database.

pipeline.name: nf-core/detaxizer
pipeline.core_rule: Columns are sample, short_reads_fastq_1, short_reads_fastq_2, long_reads_fastq_1. NOTE the non-standard read column names: this pipeline does NOT use fastq_1/fastq_2. The 1.3.0 schema marks none of them strictly required, but a row with no reads does nothing.
pipeline.reference_requirement: Only `genome` is declared at 1.3.0; there is no fasta or gtf parameter. Contamination references come from the classifier databases, not from the usual reference tree.

validation_rules: The read columns are short_reads_fastq_1 / short_reads_fastq_2, not fastq_1 / fastq_2.
Do NOT pass --fasta or --gtf: the 1.3.0 schema declares neither.
Keep enable_filter false on a first pass. Identification is reversible; filtering the reads is not.
Leave classification_kraken2 and validation_blastn off unless a database path is supplied — neither is provisioned on Luria.
long_reads_fastq_1 is for long-read libraries; NExtSEEK holds none, so leave it blank.
notes: Applies to any library type, so it is always technically runnable on the 2,057 D.SEQ records we hold. Its natural uses are pre-deposit screening and chasing suspected host or index contamination. Note the default action is to REPORT, not to remove.

sources.label: nf-core/detaxizer nextflow_schema.json @ 1.3.0
sources.notes: Authoritative: no required params beyond input/outdir; only `genome` declared among the reference options.

sources.label: nf-core/detaxizer assets/schema_input.json @ 1.3.0
sources.notes: Authoritative columns: sample, short_reads_fastq_1, short_reads_fastq_2, long_reads_fastq_1; the schema marks none as strictly required.

samplesheet_columns.description: Column-level field dictionary for the nf-core/detaxizer input samplesheet.

long_reads_fastq_1.validation_hints: Leave blank — no long-read data exists here.

report_writer_guidance.purpose: Build an nf-core/detaxizer sheet from any resolved D.SEQ cohort.
report_writer_guidance.workflow_role: Selected for contamination screening, host removal, or a pre-deposit check.
population_priority: Establish which taxon the user considers contamination; the default is human.
Leave enable_filter false unless the user explicitly asked to rewrite the reads.
final_checks: Read columns use the short_reads_ prefix.
